name: Disable collisions
displayDescription: Allows disabling item collisions. (Flatrides/stations cannot overlap, paths cannot overlap, terrain cannot overlap.)

name: 24 extra expansion plots
displayDescription:
*Rejoin the server after purchasing a gamepass!* (unless bought in-game)

Unlocks 24 extra plots of land on all your (current and future) parks (6144 tiles).

The extra plots of land are only obtainable though this game pass. Buying this game pass will instantly unlock 24 expansion plots, no additional in-game currency is required.

name: Enable Ride operations
displayDescription:
*Rejoin the server after purchasing a gamepass!* (unless bought in-game)

Allows you to change ride parameters in the Operations tab of any ride with a track. You can modify booster speed, chainlift speed, track friction, brakes speed and the vehicle target speed (if the ride supports it).

name: Increased height limit
displayDescription:
*Rejoin the server after purchasing a gamepass!* (unless bought in-game)

Increases the height limit by 10 blocks upwards (40 studs, 20 meters). You can then build up to 90 meters high. This increases the height limit for all your parks, including your existing parks.

name: Extra colors
displayDescription: Allows you to use many extra colors using the second color selector in your theme parks. If you have text chatting enabled (and if text chat is supported on the platform you play on) you can customize your chat name color as well.

name: Jukebox (custom music)
displayDescription:
Desktop/mobile only!

*Rejoin the server after purchasing a gamepass!* (unless bought in-game)

Allows you to build a jukebox (in the Scenery -> Other menu). Click the jukebox to change the music playlist. You can add any uploaded sound from the ROBLOX catalog longer than 5 seconds that 'allows copying' and add up to 50 sounds to your playlist (except for music uploaded by Roblox). This also allows you to select on-ride music for rides in your parks.

Ingame the Jukebox costs $250 (ingame money). Played sounds are heard by other players in your park too (unless they have muted their own sound).
